title: Cheesy Vegan Cauliflower Nachos!
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldKeywords: cauliflower, cheese, healthy, nacho, nachos, recipe, vegan
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ cup raw cashews (softened if needed, see instructions)
2 tablespoons tapioca starch ((also called tapioca flour))
1 cup vegan meat crumbles or vegan bacon bits (homemade or store-bought *see notes for recipe options)
1 cup black beans ((I used canned) drained and rinsed)
1/4 cup vegan sour cream or plain vegan yogurt
ldInstructionsRaw: Assemble the cheesy vegan cauliflower nachos:
htmlIngredientLines: [vegan nacho cheese (or sub store-bought vegan cheese)]
▢ ½ cup raw cashews, softened if needed, see instructions
▢ 2 tablespoons tapioca starch, (also called tapioca flour)
[toppings (optional, choose however many toppings you like)]
▢ 1 cup vegan meat crumbles or vegan bacon bits, homemade or store-bought *see notes for recipe options
▢ 1 cup black beans, (I used canned) drained and rinsed
▢ ¼ cup vegan sour cream or plain vegan yogurt
